description: Configuration file that controls how the devcontainer scaffolds a new Payload CMS project. This file is the single source of truth for project name, template, database settings, and agent integration.

projectName.description: The folder name for the generated Payload project (lowercase, numbers, hyphens only)
projectName.title: Projectname

template.description: Which official Payload starter template to scaffold

example.description: Optional: Use a specific Payload example repository instead of a template
example.title: Example

agent.description: Coding agent skill to install. Use 'none' inside disposable dev containers to keep things clean.

dbAdapter.description: Database adapter to configure for the generated project

dbName.description: Logical database name (used when creating the database in Postgres/Mongo)
dbName.title: Dbname

dbUri.description: Full database connection string. In the devcontainer flow this is typically overridden at runtime from the live .devcontainer/.env (which contains the real credentials generated by init-env.sh). You can leave a placeholder here.
dbUri.title: Dburi

adminEmail.description: Email address for the initial admin user created in the Payload admin panel
adminEmail.title: Adminemail

telemetry.description: Whether to enable Payload's anonymous telemetry
telemetry.title: Telemetry

title: XGIC Create Payload Config
